media.title: Lotus Notes release interface history — grouped publication
media.creator: IBM developerWorks, The History of Notes and Domino, 2005 revised 2007; NotesMail-hosted primary PDF

observations.observation: Complete relevant pages 4,6,7,8,10,11,13,20,21 were rendered and inspected: R1 cyan menu/pink workspace/yellow message child window; R2 gray overlapping list/document windows and colored workspace tabs; R3 icon toolbar/search/list workspace; R4 tree/list/preview mail, textured database tiles; R4.5 yellow month calendar and highlighted date; R5 white welcome page with large circular mail/calendar/address/task icons and browser-like bar; R6 pale aqua welcome/search and icon row; R8 blue tabbed multi-pane mail/sidebar map; Sales Lead Browser composite app has company filter, lead table and paired lower detail panes. One conservative publication count, not nine releases/screens or each constituent app. Small embedded originals support broad structure/color and legible headings, not exact tiny type/fabrication. All controls are still affordances, not tested interactions.
